task: Constrain ultralight boson properties from black hole superradiance using a Bayesian framework over full mass-spin posterior samples.
named_commitments: Use full posterior distributions of black hole mass and spin measurements, not point estimates
Translate black hole superradiance physics into a probabilistic model
Derive statistically rigorous upper limits on ultralight boson mass
Derive constraints on self-interaction coupling strengths
Use available SMBH and stellar-mass black hole datasets as primary sources
derived_requirements_from_related_work: Represent constraints as exclusion probability functions versus boson mass
Report source-specific and combined 68%/95% exclusion summaries
